authority: JAYT-391 — directive supplied directly by user
reviewer: Codex CEO; Gemini safety review required for pipeline seal

hard_prohibitions: Do not bypass, evade or defeat WAF, CAPTCHA, authentication, rate limits, robots directives, geo controls, paywalls, provider terms or access controls.
Do not create, alter or infer source bytes, dates, scope, terms, codes, Mall status, inventory, price, media or provider attribution.
Do not silently mutate published factual content or enable affiliate attribution without provider-issued replayable proof.

lanes.purpose: Independently qualify local F&B and cinema offers; KTX acquisition status must not block this lane.
tasks: For each retained first-party artifact, create 06_TRUST_AND_EVIDENCE/j391/deals/<offer_id>.quotes.json containing four verbatim, byte-locatable quotations: offer_quote, validity_quote, scope_quote and terms_quote.

Record source artifact path, source SHA-256, byte offsets or robust selectors, captured timestamp, source URL and extraction method. Quotes must be present in the retained artifact, not in executor-authored metadata.

Classify each offer VERIFIED_DANANG only if all four predicates prove the exact offer, active period, Da Nang scope/branch, and relevant eligibility. Otherwise classify VERIFIED_REGIONAL, SOURCE_INSUFFICIENT or EXPIRED and keep it out of the Da Nang Wave-1 count.

Render cards only for independently qualifying records. Display Copy Code only if the source artifact visibly contains a real public code; otherwise use only the source-supported app/counter CTA. Zalo Pass may share non-sensitive public offer information only.
Produce a validator that reads the raw files and rejects missing quote, mismatched hash, absent scope/date/terms predicate, self-reference, fabricated code and invalid CTA.
wave_1_release_gate: All 15 records must separately satisfy four-quote extraction before a 15-deal Da Nang release claim. A partial verified set may be reviewed and released only with its exact count and exclusions disclosed.
CEO independently verifies the source bindings and served cards before any alias mutation.

lanes.purpose: Keep 30 KTX records in neutral survey mode until clean evidence is legitimately available.
tasks: Stop repeated bare-request capture patterns that yield challenge/404 responses. A challenge is recorded once as a block condition and is not retried aggressively.

Use only a provider-authorized data feed/API or a browser session the provider expressly permits. Retain authorization/source terms, original bytes, response metadata and hash. If unavailable, retain neutral placeholder and unverified status.

For each claimed verified SKU, enforce 1 itemId = 1 canonical URL = 1 matching product/variant = 1 rights-documented local image = hash binding. Decode and manually inspect media; reject reused, generic or mismatched content.
Affiliate remains false until a provider-issued replayable attribution validation binds that exact provider and SKU.

Install a four-hour scheduler only on a user-owned, approved host with a dedicated least-privilege account. The scheduler accepts fixed audited item IDs only, retains immutable run logs, and does not auto-publish factual changes.

Submit scheduler registration proof, configuration, host/identity attestation, one scheduled (not manually triggered) run log and an alert delivery record. Simulated timings must be labelled simulations.

For rollback measurement, submit a separate test-target plan. Do not alter the canonical production alias without explicit execution authorization. Any real drill must log pre/post alias, timestamps, CDN response checks and restoration to the original alias.
Keep 200 as observation, 3xx/403/429/timeout as UNKNOWN, and require repeated 404/410 observations plus review before safe card suppression.

After both lanes have a reviewed form, create 08_RELEASE_VAULT/PIPELINE_SEAL_MANIFEST.json listing every sealed runner, collector, validator, schema and their SHA-256 hashes, with an explicit change-control policy.

The manifest must remain PENDING_DUAL_KEY until it contains two independently verifiable approvals: Chairman written approval reference and Gemini safety-review reference. Executor/CEO declarations alone do not satisfy Gemini approval.

Provide a verification script that fails on hash/schema drift and reports seal status. The seal cannot technically prevent all local filesystem edits; operational enforcement is via restricted write access, code review and the two recorded approvals.

reporting.T_plus_3h: Report four-quote verified/insufficient/excluded counts per deal; no deployment claim until CEO review.
reporting.T_plus_12h: Report clean KTX evidence/media count, challenge blocks, actual scheduler proof, and rollback proof. State simulations separately.
reporting.completion: Report exact evidence counts and unresolved blockers. Executor cannot claim CEO, Gemini or commercial Go-Live PASS.
